### Where parallel speedup tapers off (32 MiB, n=r=16, z=1)

This machine has 12 logical CPUs (4 P-cores with Hyper-Threading = 8 threads, plus 4 E-cores). **Knee T** is the last thread count where adding threads still gained ≥5%; past it the curve is flat or falling. The Amdahl fraction is fitted on T≤8.
